marketBrief.headline: Close, Nov. 12: Stocks finish lower as Nvidia falls 4% and the 10-year yield tops 5%
marketBrief.summary: The S&P 500 closed down 0.35% at 7,592.40, the Dow fell 0.36% to 52,297.09 and the Nasdaq Composite lost 0.39% to 25,366.09, per AP, after an early loss of nearly 1% was largely erased. Nvidia closed down 4.34% after Jensen Huang resigned (Yahoo Finance quote data). The 10-year Treasury yield rose above 5%, about 5.125% in CNBC's report, as traders priced a December rate hike (CNBC).
bullets: Nvidia closed down 4.34% at $166.19 after Huang resigned and CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO (Yahoo Finance; CNBC).
Treasuries: 10-year up more than 13 bp to 5.125%, 2-year 4.879%, 30-year 5.449% (CNBC). Yahoo Finance quote data showed the 10-year at 5.10%.
Oil: WTI closed up more than 2% at $88.74 and Brent rose more than 3% to $95.82 after Trump said the US does not need a deal with Iran (CNBC).
Week: S&P 500 up 2.9%, Dow up 2.0%, Nasdaq up 3.2% (AP).
Cisco and Applied Materials reported after the close with revenue beats; see the earnings story. Friday brings October PPI at 8:30 a.m. ET (BLS schedule).
